name: Mechanical Engineering
summary: A practice-first mechanical engineering degree, with company projects from early on and a six-month internship built into the final year. It is aimed at going straight into industry after three and a half years rather than at a research career, though a master's remains open. It offers the broadest set of alternative science entry combinations at SDU.
